items: 【Rustic & Vintage Design】A frame made of black steel meets board in a rustic style. This console table not only gives an attractive vintage look but also features superior durability and stability. Ideal as a console table, entrance or hallway table, sofa couch table, or even a TV table in the living room and bedroom.

【3 Tiers of Extra Storage】The 42-inch x 12-inch long table top provides more storage space, the overall height of the table is 30 inches with four adjustable legs for more space saving. The 2 tiers of shelves underneath the wood shelves provide extra space for your books, plants, shoes, bags, or boxes for your essentials.

【Stable and Reliable Raw Materials】When it comes to quality, it is something you should expect. The sturdy frame crafted from premium metal offers high strength and will decrease shake, which makes the entryway table more stable and secure.

【Easy to Set up】Very easy to assemble, simply tighten the screws and adjustable feet in position, assembly mission is accomplished. With a simple structure and detailed instructions, you'll have it assembled before you know it. The L-shaped Allen wrench is provided.
【What You Get 】A 3-tier console table with a rustic top and 2 shelves, clear instructions to simplify assembly, and a great way to make your home more attractive.
The boards of this 3-tier console table are made of FSC-certified wood.
